title: What are some of your favorite uses of licensed music in film, in your opinion?

commenti.body:
My favorite is at the end of The Social Network. We've seen how low Mark is it, he's going to have to settle and finds himself all alone after a grueling lawsuit with the guy who was one of his closest friends. He sends Erica Albright, his girlfriend who dumps him in the opening scene of the movie, a Facebook friend request. And just sits there hitting refresh over and over again while The Beatles Baby You're a Rich Man comes on. 


It's the perfect coda to the movie. He's finally in the final club he always wanted, he built it himself, he's one of the Beautiful People, and it's gotten him nowhere.

The first song that came to my mind was the funky rendition of 'Also Sprach Zarathustra' by Deodato that plays in the movie 'Being There' while Chauncey Gardener explores the outside world for the first time. I love that sequence.
